definitions.explanation: The outer layer or exterior of something.
What appears on the outside, as opposed to what is hidden or internal.

examples.english: Ice has formed on the surface of the water.

examples.japanese: {表面|ひょうめん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平|へい}{和|わ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{内|うち}{部|ぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: On the surface it looks peaceful, but there are problems inside.

examples.japanese: {表面|ひょうめん}⟦{張力|ちょうりょく}→張力：28197_chouryoku⟧⟦について→について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.notes: ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}{張力|ちょうりょく}→表面張力：noentry⟧ = surface tension (physics)

examples.japanese: ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}{的|てき}→表面的：18749_hyoumenteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：02350_yoi⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: On the surface, they seem to get along well.
examples.notes: ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}{的|てき}→表面的：18749_hyoumenteki⟧ = superficial, on the surface

examples.japanese: ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}{上|じょう}→表面上：17830_hyoumenjou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}して→賛成する：05647_sanseisuru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧だろう。
examples.english: On the surface they agree, but they're probably against it in reality.
examples.notes: ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}{上|じょう}→表面上：17830_hyoumenjou⟧ = superficially, ostensibly

examples.japanese: ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表面|ひょうめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}いた→磨く：02427_migaku⟧。
examples.english: I polished the surface of the desk.

notes:
{表面|ひょうめん} means surface — both the physical outer layer of an object and figuratively the outward appearance of a situation.

PHYSICAL SENSE:
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表面|ひょうめん}: water surface
- {表面|ひょうめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish the surface
- {表面|ひょうめん}⟦{張力|ちょうりょく}→張力：28197_chouryoku⟧: surface tension (physics)

FIGURATIVE SENSE:
- ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}{上|じょう}→表面上：17830_hyoumenjou⟧: superficially, on the surface
- ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}{的|てき}→表面的：18749_hyoumenteki⟧（な）: superficial
- {表面|ひょうめん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: on the surface it seems ~, but...

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{裏面|りめん}→裏面：18245_rimen⟧: reverse side, back surface.
- ⟦{外見|がいけん}→外見：12114_gaiken⟧: outward appearance (of people)
- ⟦{見|み}かけ→見かけ：08214_mikake⟧: appearance (casual)
